Münchner Klaviersommer: Burton & Ozone

Vibraphonist Gary Burton and pianist Makoto Ozone, both great jazz players noted for their virtuoso technique and innovative style, performed at 'Münchner Klaviersommer', an annual concert series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.
